scope: Current response to the 25-flaw review; implemented does not assert formal program verification.

findings.title: Compiler proof boundary
findings.contract: Whole-compiler semantics remain open; checked-box proves reconstructed bounded original equations.

findings.title: Mordell global completeness
findings.contract: All 457 curve-specific global rank, saturation and coordinate bounds remain formal obligations.

findings.title: Industrial portfolio regression
findings.contract: Default transport mode keeps original assertions; portfolio requires explicit experimental opt-in. No arithmetic speedup claimed.

findings.title: General effective solving
findings.contract: Arbitrary degree <=32 and exponents 2..16 now have checked finite-x answers within budget; global Baker remains open.

findings.title: Matveev premises
findings.contract: Named analytic premises remain undischargeable by finite packet checks.

findings.title: General Sturm correctness
findings.contract: Finite exact queries avoid real-root assumptions; general Sturm variation remains open.

findings.title: Population rank/select execution
findings.contract: Original-equation bounded list count, selection and first-occurrence rank now kernel-check; generic population interpreter remains open.

findings.title: Optimization proof pipeline
findings.contract: Finite-x polynomial minimum and all tied original points kernel-check; unbounded optimization remains open.

findings.title: Number-ring orbit completion
findings.contract: General norm representatives and effective exponent bounds remain open.

findings.title: Runge recognition and cost
findings.contract: Bounded original-polynomial route does not require Runge leading-coefficient recognition; global recognition and sharper bounds remain open.

findings.title: Smooth/mesh metric identification
findings.contract: Polyhedral guarantees remain separate from general smooth metric transport.

findings.title: General certified periods
findings.contract: Existing supported genus-two closures retained; arbitrary marked normalized periods remain open.

findings.title: Irregular singular execution
findings.contract: Incoming supported rank-one certified Stokes computation now covers no closed forms, repeated eigenvalues and ramified scalar reductions; arbitrary irregular systems outside that framework and Lean execution remain open.

findings.title: Wild dyadic reduction
findings.contract: Incoming Galois-conductor computations now cover split genus-two Jacobians at 2 and supported odd wild cases; general nonsplit wild genus-two conductors at 2, Tamagawa data and Lean refinement remain open.

findings.title: All-level Weil formalization
findings.contract: General intertwining and orbit-bound formalization remain open.

findings.title: Gamma correctness bridges
findings.contract: General Lean residue-block factorial-unit correctness and the sufficient Landau integrality direction now proved. Reconstructed original-factorial queries kernel-check within budgets. The Landau converse and Python interpreter refinement remain open.

findings.title: Runtime assets absent from installation
findings.contract: Wheel and sdist include curated mathematical sources, certificates, core receipts, data and atlas.

findings.title: Fragmented dependencies
findings.contract: Named analytic, intervals, industrial and research extras expose feature installation contracts.

findings.title: Portable installation coverage
findings.contract: CI adds independent installed-wheel checks across Windows, Linux and macOS and supported Python versions.

findings.title: Resource-heavy proof reproduction
findings.contract: New checker uses Std-only library and compiles without Mathlib; historical heavy modules retain their cost.

findings.title: Incomplete release feature contract
findings.contract: Release manifest validates required paths, test coverage and focused checks; extended gate is required by release-verify.

findings.title: HTTP availability
findings.contract: Bounded clients, absolute header/body deadline, serial terminable query process and independent health handlers. Mutation timeout may leave committed state.

findings.title: Historical/current status ambiguity
findings.contract: This single current ledger separates implemented changes, bounded extensions and open research; historical sections are explicitly subordinate.

findings.title: External adoption evidence
findings.contract: Independent solver regressions retained and transport gains remain scoped; no production adoption or commercial speedup inferred.

findings.title: Observed physics predictions
findings.contract: CKM, physical CP selection and alpha(0) remain unpredicted; model computations do not discharge these mechanisms.
